correctness.rationale: Given the source, observed replicated maximal-run totals are exactly sums of independent positive dwell times. The sum over observations of each posterior maximum factors across original constant runs. An extreme composition yields the universal \(a_1^{r-1}\) bound; outward transfers for log-convex dwell pmfs attain it, inward transfers for log-concave pmfs prove the balanced double series, and the strict comparison at total \(L=r+2\) proves separation. Markov tilting and conditional simulation prove additional claims. Exact-rational finite enumeration checked geometric, log-convex mixture, log-concave factorial-tail cases and Markov identity, without extrapolating finite experiments to infinite proof.

value.rationale: Perfect source-indexed dwell recovery is a motivated synchronization invariant of sticky/nanopore replication. This solves its exact noiseless MAP probability for any known word, proves a sharp universal bound across all positive iid dwell laws and an unexpected log-convex equality class, plus a complementary log-concave exact series and source-law/noise consequences. These characterize a natural all-parameter family rather than an arbitrary finite slice or a restatement of channel capacity.
